DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: A named WebCrawler configuration profile. search_keys, crawl_keys and output_keys are required dictionaries; every documented field in those sections is required by configuration validation.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys: Required. Performs Bing RSS web search using domain and terms to discover candidate URLs. The provider may return fewer URLs than max_results. Search web displays candidates only; all crawl actions search first. Provider/network failures are reported as failures.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.domain: Required. Domain to restrict search results to, for example 'wikipedia.org'.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.terms: Required. List of terms to search for. Only terms actually found on pages are included in crawler results.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.max_results: Required. Maximum number of search result URLs collected for each search term.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys: Required. Configures Photon and Selenium crawl depth, page limits and delays. The selected menu action determines which crawler runs.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.photon_depth: Required. Maximum Photon crawl depth from each discovered search result URL.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.selenium_depth: Required. Maximum Selenium link depth from each candidate; zero checks only candidates.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.selenium_max_pages: Required. Maximum pages attempted across all Selenium candidates in one crawl.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.download_delay: Required. Delay in seconds after Selenium loads a page before its rendered text is checked.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.output_keys.output_dir: Required. Full output directory for this group. Supports ~ and is created if required. Result JSON filenames use the group name.
